title: thank you, enjoyed the "essentials class"
text: enjoyed this tapas and jamon tasting - curated selection of "must try" popular tapas - included spanish tortilla, pan with tomato, russian salad, manchego cheese and of course, varieties of jamon.  friendly and attentive staff.  it was a last minute booking for us to ensure we had sampled the BCN highlights - we were eating dinner anyways!
author: Trisha_K
